description: Repo-scale (express-ts-shortlink): archiving a link (new PATCH /api/links/:slug/archive) must be excluded from the list, the direct fetch, AND the redirect route - 3 call sites
prompts: Add an `archived` flag to links (`archived?: boolean` on the `Link` model) and a new `PATCH /api/links/:slug/archive` endpoint that sets it. Once a link is archived, it must disappear everywhere - this spans three separate route handlers: (1) `GET /api/links` must exclude archived links from the list, (2) `GET /api/links/:slug` must 404 for an archived link exactly as if it didn't exist, and (3) `GET /r/:slug` (the redirect route, in `src/routes/redirect.ts`) must 404 for an archived link instead of redirecting - and must NOT record a click for it.
name: add_shortlink_archive_cascade
